verdict.answer: `ta.tr(true)` IS candA — `na(close[1]) ? high - low : max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))`
verdict.awayFromBarZero: IDENTICAL to `ta.tr(false)`, to candA and to candB — 0.0 difference on every bar of both readings, no floating-point residue at all.
verdict.atBarZero: CARRIES A VALUE, and that value is `high - low`. `ta.tr(false)` is `na` on the same bar, and so is the unguarded candB.

bar_zero_leg._why: ⭐ THE SYMBOL IS THE INSTRUMENT HERE. On SPY the study's output window never reaches `bar_index == 0` — TradingView computes from further back than it returns, so the discriminator cannot fire however long the chart is left to load. CRWV listed 2025-03-28, so its ENTIRE history (366 bars) fits inside the window and the first output row IS bar 0. Same precedent as `r11-nvi`, which had to read SPY's 1993 seed on a monthly chart.

_the_discriminator_and_why_it_matters: ⛔ THE WHOLE CLAIM LIVES ON ONE BAR, AND A LONG-HISTORY SYMBOL CANNOT SHOW IT. Every difference channel reads 0.0 on SPY over 2,244 bars across two readings — which is agreement, not proof, because bar 0 is outside the study's output window there. The three boolean channels are what make bar 0 readable without comparing floats: `subject_is_na = 0` says a value is present, `subject_eq_highlow = 1` says that value is the spread, and `sibling_is_na = 1` says the `false` form has none. All three fired on CRWV's first bar simultaneously. ⭐ And `SPREAD_control` is non-zero on every bar of every leg (min 0.59, max 55.57, zero count 0), so no leg is the silent-zero shape where a study that never ran reads as agreement.
_the_probe_defect_this_capture_found: ⚰️ THE FIRST ATTEMPT COULD NOT ANSWER ITS OWN QUESTION, and the probe carried the defect, not the rig. `max_bars_back = 500` was declared for no reason (the script needs exactly one bar of history, `close[1]`), and TradingView spends declared history as warm-up: the study produced 1,829 rows starting 2019 and `is_first_bar` was 0 on every one. On the `All` range — 405 monthly bars — it produced NOTHING AT ALL, which is the same fact stated louder: a 500-bar warm-up cannot be paid out of a 405-bar series. The declaration is removed and the reason is written at the line in the probe.
_bounds: ⚠️ ONE READING PER LEG, TWO SYMBOLS, ONE TIMEFRAME. The agreement half is SPY 1D over 2019-06-04 → 2026-09-11 and 2025-01-16 → 2026-09-11; the bar-0 half is CRWV 1D, 366 bars, and it rests on the first bar of ONE listing. ⛔ It says nothing about intraday first bars, about a symbol whose first bar has `na` inputs, or about what `ta.tr(true)` does when the series has gaps — none of which this engine has a reason to ask yet. The 0.0 differences are exact zeros, not rounded: no tolerance was applied anywhere in this fixture.
